title: Jordan's three Macs run the download
done_when: each Mac shows v6.1.0 in the panel after one last permission re-grant
body: On each Mac: download v6.1.0, open it, let it move to ~/Applications over the old app (S-6 keeps config.json and the LaunchAgent), then re-grant the two permissions once, because the signing identity changes. The source checkout stays for the developer route.
